notes:
Short summary: POC concluded; account moved to closed-lost (competitor). Main reason: measurable quality regression versus incumbent in structured outputs and tool-calling reliability. They were evaluating Redwood-hosted and Dedicated options for commerce search + checkout orchestration.

POC findings (concise):
- Overall: Redwood delivered good throughput and latency, but key quality metrics regressed vs incumbent (EchelonAI).
- Structured extraction: order_total and purchase_intent slot exact-match dropped from 92% (incumbent) to 73% (Redwood POC). Failures were schema-mismatch and occasional tokenization split on currency strings.
- Tool-calling: 18% of calls produced malformed JSON or incorrect action name (e.g., "createOrder" vs expected "fulfill_order") leading to downstream API errors. Incumbent was ~2% failure rate.
- Hallucinations: product attribute hallucination (e.g., color/size) in 6% of responses affecting trust in checkout confirmations.
- Latency/cost: Redwood latency and cost met target; not a blocker. Quality is the blocker.

Security/process:
- Ironwood required SSO (SAML), strict audit logging, KMS-integrated key control, and EU data residency for EU traffic. Redwood Private would technically meet those but procurement hit a budget freeze and SE couldn't get security sign-off before competitor contract was finalized.

Sales notes / quote:
- VP Product: "Accuracy dropped in our critical purchase-intent slots — can't risk it in checkout flows."
- Head of Platform: liked Redwood's dev experience but worried about regression risk in customer-facing flow.

Internal AE/SE actions recorded:
- 2024-09-15: initial discovery call (Sasha/Diego).
- 2024-10-01: technical deep-dive; security checklist reviewed.
- 2024-11-03: POC kickoff (2-week seed dataset + live shadow traffic).
- 2024-12-10: mid-POC review (fireflies ff_2024-12-10_poc-review). Observed early schema drift; SE suggested rule-based post-processing.
- 2025-01-15: final POC results sent (drive:/drive/deals/ironwood/poc_results_2025-01-15.pdf).
- 2025-02-07: procurement paused (budget freeze). Competitor agreement signed 2025-02-09. Last outreach 2025-02-10.

Reason lost / recommended follow-up:
- Lost to EchelonAI primarily due to measurable quality/regression in structured output and tool-calling reliability. Security + budget freeze accelerated decision. No strong internal champion to extend POC or fund dedicated work on model quality.
- Recommended: track model improvements, prepare a short brief showing targeted fixes (structured extraction retraining, constrained decoding for tool-call JSON validation, schema-enforced generation). Re-engage in Q3 or when budget opens.

CRM tone: clipped bullets, multiple action items, several handoffs. Archive as closed-lost; set reminder for 2025-08 re-engage.
